name: SurveyAnalyticsWorkflow
description: Processes survey responses to generate real-time analytics, statistical summaries, and visualizations with response filtering, segmentation, and trend analysis

data.label: Start Analytics Process
data.description: Triggered when analytics generation is requested for a survey

data.label: Validate Survey Data
data.description: Verify survey exists, has responses, and user has analytics permissions

data.label: Sufficient Responses?
data.description: Check if survey has minimum responses for meaningful analytics

data.label: Filter & Segment Responses
data.description: Apply filters, create segments based on demographics, time periods, and custom criteria

data.label: Calculate Statistics
data.description: Compute response rates, averages, distributions, correlations, and statistical summaries

data.label: Generate Insights
data.description: Use AI to analyze open-ended responses, identify trends, and generate actionable insights

data.label: Prepare Visualizations
data.description: Generate chart data, graphs, heat maps, and dashboard components

data.label: Create Analytics Snapshot
data.description: Save analytics snapshot to database for historical tracking and comparison

data.label: Notify Analytics Ready
data.description: Send notification to users that analytics report is available

data.label: Notify Insufficient Data
data.description: Alert user that survey needs more responses for analytics

data.label: Analytics Complete
data.description: Analytics generation process completed successfully

data.label: Process Terminated
data.description: Process ended due to insufficient data

name: UserManagementWorkflow
description: Manages user registration, authentication, role assignment, and profile management with organization membership and access control

data.label: Start User Management
data.description: Initiate user management process

data.label: Submit User Request
data.description: User submits registration or profile update request

data.label: Validate User Data
data.description: Validate email format, password strength, required fields, and duplicate checks

data.label: Validation Passed?
data.description: Check if user data meets all validation requirements

data.label: Send Validation Error
data.description: Notify user of validation errors and required corrections

data.label: Create/Update User Account
data.description: Process user account creation or update in database

data.label: Assign Roles & Permissions
data.description: Admin assigns user roles and organization membership

data.label: Configure Access Control
data.description: Set up user permissions, organization access, and survey visibility

data.label: Send Welcome Email
data.description: Send account confirmation and credentials to user

data.label: End
data.description: User management process complete

name: SurveyDistributionWorkflow
description: Manages survey distribution and invitation sending to respondents via email or shareable links, with tracking and reminder scheduling

data.label: Start Distribution
data.description: Initiate survey distribution process

data.label: Validate Survey & Recipients
data.description: Verify survey is published and recipient list is valid

data.label: Distribution Method?
data.description: Determine if distribution is via email invitations or shareable link

data.label: Generate Shareable Link
data.description: Create unique shareable link and update SurveyDistribution record

data.label: Prepare Email Invitations
data.description: Generate personalized invitation tokens and tracking links for each respondent

data.label: Send Email Invitations
data.description: Distribute survey invitations via email to respondent list

data.label: Update Distribution Analytics
data.description: Record distribution metrics and create AnalyticsSnapshot

data.label: Schedule Reminders
data.description: Set up automated reminder notifications for non-respondents

data.label: Notify Distribution Complete
data.description: Send confirmation to survey owner with distribution summary

data.label: End
data.description: Distribution process complete

name: SurveyTemplateWorkflow
description: Manages survey template creation from existing surveys, template library management, instantiation of surveys from templates, and tracks template usage and popularity metrics

data.label: Start Template Process
data.description: Initiates survey template workflow - creation or instantiation

data.label: Template Action Type
data.description: Determine if creating new template or instantiating from existing

data.label: Configure Template Details
data.description: User defines template name, description, category, and visibility settings

data.label: Extract Survey Structure
data.description: Process source survey to extract questions, branching rules, and configuration

data.label: Validate Template
data.description: Ensure template meets quality standards and has required components

data.label: Save to Template Library
data.description: Store template in library with metadata and indexing

data.label: Select Template
data.description: User browses and selects template from library

data.label: Instantiate Survey
data.description: Create new survey instance from template with all questions and rules

data.label: Track Template Usage
data.description: Update usage count and popularity metrics for analytics

data.label: Notify User
data.description: Send confirmation notification about template action completion

data.label: End Process
data.description: Template workflow completed successfully

name: DataExportWorkflow
description: Handles exporting survey responses and analytics to various formats (CSV, PDF) with asynchronous job processing and download link provisioning

data.label: Start Export Request
data.description: User initiates survey data export request

data.label: Validate Export Parameters
data.description: Validate survey ID, format type, date ranges, and user permissions

data.label: Check Data Volume
data.description: Determine if export requires async processing based on response count

data.label: Create Export Job
data.description: Create ExportJob record for large dataset with queued status

data.label: Generate Export File
data.description: Process responses, apply filters, transform data to requested format (CSV/PDF)

data.label: Generate Immediate Export
data.description: Synchronously generate export file for small datasets

data.label: Store File & Generate Link
data.description: Upload file to storage, generate secure download link with expiration

data.label: Notify User
data.description: Send email with download link and export details to requesting user

data.label: Export Complete
data.description: Export workflow completed successfully

name: SurveyCreationWorkflow
description: Manages the complete survey creation and editing process from initial setup through question building, branching logic configuration, validation, and preview before publishing

data.label: Start Survey Creation
data.description: Initiate survey creation process - new or from template

data.label: Creation Method
data.description: Determine if creating from scratch or from template

data.label: Setup Survey Details
data.description: User enters survey title, description, settings, and basic configuration

data.label: Load Template
data.description: Load selected SurveyTemplate and populate Survey with template questions and settings

data.label: Build Questions
data.description: User creates/edits questions, adds QuestionOptions, configures question types and validation

data.label: Configure Branching Logic
data.description: User sets up BranchingRules for conditional question flow and skip logic

data.label: Validate Survey Structure
data.description: Validate survey has required questions, valid branching rules, and proper configuration

data.label: Validation Result
data.description: Check if survey passes validation checks

data.label: Preview & Finalize
data.description: User previews survey, makes final adjustments, and saves as draft or ready for distribution

data.label: Notify Validation Errors
data.description: Send validation error messages to user for correction

data.label: Survey Created
data.description: Survey creation process completed successfully

name: ResponseCollectionWorkflow
description: Manages survey response submission with validation, branching logic, partial save support, and completion tracking for both anonymous and authenticated respondents

data.label: Start Response Collection
data.description: Respondent initiates survey response submission

data.label: Validate Survey Access
data.description: Check if survey is active, not expired, and respondent has access permissions

data.label: Access Valid?
data.description: Determine if respondent can proceed with survey

data.label: Fill Survey Questions
data.description: Respondent answers survey questions with branching logic support

data.label: Apply Branching Rules
data.description: Evaluate branching rules based on answers to determine next questions

data.label: Survey Complete?
data.description: Check if all required questions answered or partial save requested

data.label: Save Partial Response
data.description: Store incomplete response with current progress for later completion

data.label: Validate Response Data
data.description: Validate all answers against question rules and required fields

data.label: Validation Passed?
data.description: Check if response meets all validation criteria

data.label: Save Complete Response
data.description: Store validated response, update completion tracking, and link to respondent

data.label: Send Confirmation
data.description: Notify respondent of successful submission and thank them

data.label: Send Access Denied
data.description: Notify respondent that survey is unavailable or access is restricted

data.label: Response Submitted
data.description: Response collection completed successfully

data.label: Access Denied
data.description: Response collection terminated due to access restrictions

data.label: Partial Save Complete
data.description: Partial response saved for later completion
